explication: SGLang-Omni is a multi-stage serving runtime for multimodal, speech, transcription, and text-to-speech models, with an OpenAI-compatible API and a multi-worker router. The principal workflow is a client request entering a serving surface, being scheduled across model-specific stages, transferring payloads between stages, and returning generated audio, text, or multimodal output. The graph groups model families rather than enumerating each implementation. Relationship evidence is limited to the README and sampled/indexed files; unsampled model wiring is not asserted.
